entries.title: Vacuum gripper
entries.query_text:
Vacuum gripper
A vacuum gripper comprises a rigid base element and a loop-shaped vacuum seal element. The base element has first and second opposite sides. The seal element is attached at least indirectly to the second side and protruding therefrom in a direction away from the first side. The seal element comprises a contact surface that at least partially contacts with an object surface and an encircling surface oriented transversely to the contact surface so as to define a chamber. The seal element is elastically deformable at the contact surface to enable conforming to the object surface when pressed thereagainst. The vacuum gripper comprises an air extraction means mounted to the first side to be in fluid communication with the chamber through the base element, and configured to continuously extract air from the chamber to cause the contact surface to be urged towards and grip the object surface when pressed thereagainst.
Claim 1: What is claimed is: 
     
       1. A vacuum gripper for gripping an object surface, the vacuum gripper comprising:
 a base element having a first side and a second side opposite to the first side, the second side having a central area and a periphery surrounding the central area, 
 wherein said periphery of the second side of the base element is bounded by a peripheral rim and comprises a peripheral support area; 
 a seal element having an attachment surface mounted to the peripheral support area and a contact surface opposite to the attachment surface; 
 an air extraction means mounted to the first side of the base element so as to be in fluid communication with a chamber defined by the second side and the seal element and configured to extract air from the chamber; and 
 a bracing structure arranged within or outside the seal element; 
 wherein the seal element protrudes a distance from the peripheral support area no greater than a thickness of the seal element; and 
 wherein said air extraction means is operable in a variable manner by at least one of: 
 a. fluctuating operating power supplied to the air extraction means; or 
 b. reducing the power supplied to said air extraction means to a level sufficient to maintain the vacuum grip on an object comprising said object surface.

entries.title: Extended-frame portable vacuum gripper
entries.query_text:
Extended-frame portable vacuum gripper
An extended frame portable vacuum grip device is provided having a rigid unitary support frame with elongated base and peripheral support wall that can define an open chamber at a face of the device for vacuum grip connections. A plurality of corresponding components can be combined to form independent vacuum grip regions within the open chamber extending along the length of the support frame. A plurality of ports can be defined through the base along its length that can each operatively connect with a corresponding pump. A plurality of closed-loop gaskets can each mate with corresponding portions of the base and support wall within the open chamber to act as vacuum seal members and define independent vacuum grip regions. A corresponding support frame for each gasket can help retain the independent arrangement and enhance seal actions of the gasket. The grip device can include structural reinforcements for reducing applied stresses.

       1. An extended frame portable vacuum grip device comprising:
 a rigid support frame defining an open chamber, the support frame comprising:
 an impermeable elongate base having a vacuum grip side, an opposite support side, a width, and an extended length that is larger than the width, the impermeable elongate base defining at least one port therethrough; and

entries.title: Sauggreifsystem sowie Verfahren zum Betreiben eines Sauggreifsystems
entries.query_text:
Sauggreifsystem sowie Verfahren zum Betreiben eines Sauggreifsystems
Die Erfindung betrifft ein Sauggreifsystem (1) mit wenigstens zwei an einem Grundträger (3) angeordneten Saugelementen (4), welche am Ende einer jeweiligen Saugleitung (5) angeordnet und über diese mit einer Saugvorrichtung (6) verbunden sind, mittels welcher das jeweilige Saugelement (4) mit einem Unterdruck beaufschlagbar ist, wobei in einer der wenigstens zwei Saugleitungen (5) ein Strömungswiderstandselement (10) angeordnet ist. Des Weiteren betrifft die Erfindung ein Verfahren zum Betreiben eines Sauggreifsystems (1).

entries.title: Konsole, Spannmittel und Unterdruckspanneinrichtung
entries.query_text:
Konsole, Spannmittel und Unterdruckspanneinrichtung
Eine Konsole (10) für eine Unterdruckspanneinrichtung (100), wobei die Konsole (10) einen angetriebenen Mitnehmer (20) zur Verlagerung eines auf die Konsole (10) aufsetzbaren Spannmittels (60) aufweist, wobei der Mitnehmer (20) an einer Seitenwand (18) der Konsole (10) angeordnet und entlang der Konsolenlängsrichtung (12) verschieblich geführt ist, wobei vorgeschlagen wird dass der Mitnehmer (20) mindestens einen ausfahrbaren Mitnehmerzapfen (26) zur mechanischen Ankopplung eines Spannmittels (60) an den Mitnehmer (20) und eine Fluidzuführung (28) zur Beaufschlagung eines an den Mitnehmer (20) angekoppelten Spannmittels (60) mit einem insbesondere unter Druck stehenden Fluid aufweist.
 Ein Spannmittel (60) für einen Unterdruckspanneinrichtung (100) und eine Unterdruckspanneinrichtung (100) sind ebenfalls angegeben.

entries.title: Vacuum lifting device for stone elements
entries.notes: Probst vacuum lifting device for stone elements (fam 6495403); DE.
entries.query_text:
Vacuum lifting device for stone elements
The invention relates to a vacuum lifting device for stone elements and the like, having a housing (2), a fastening device (5) arranged thereon and intended for fastening the lifting device (1) to the crane hook or the like of a working apparatus, a vacuum suction device (3) for the stone elements, and a handle part (4), a device (6 to 9) for generating a vacuum for the suction device (3) being provided. Running gear (10, 11, 12, 13; 11', 11''), which supports the lifting device (1) movably and inherently stably and includes at least one wheel (11; 11'; 11''), can be fixed to the housing (2). <IMAGE>

entries.title: Lifting appliance, in particular for laying kerb stones, paving flags and the like
entries.query_text:
Lifting appliance, in particular for laying kerb stones, paving flags and the like
The invention relates to a lifting appliance having a mast which is fastened to a basic body (9) and on the free end of which a jib (6) is located, on which a lifting device (1) is arranged. The mast is of two-part design and comprises a bottom mast part (5') arranged on the basic body and a top mast part (5''), to the free end of which the jib (6) is fastened in such a way that the top mast part (5'') can be pivoted about an axis (8) in relation to the bottom mast part (5') by an actuator (7). <IMAGE>
